content:
Dylan Brooks: quick check for the demo tenant rollout — which Console views are “safe” to show live right now? trying to lock the run-of-show + backup screenshots. I’ve seen a couple screens be… spicy.

Chloe Martin: which ones are you hitting issues with?

Dylan Brooks: 1) Rollouts view sometimes loads but the table is empty even though the route has a canary config
2) Traces view: occasionally “No spans found” (even after running demo traffic)
3) Model catalog “benchmarks” tab had a 504 for me once

Logan Wright: traces empty is usually ingestion lag + project selector defaulting weirdly. if you’re landing on Traces from a deep link it can pick the last project you viewed (not demo). we’ve got a fix in review for defaulting to the demo project + 15m time range.

Allison Grant: +1. also the “Dashboard > Overview” graphs can look empty if synthetic traffic job hasn’t run in the last ~20 min. for live demo we should assume we’ll kick the generator at T-5.

Chloe Martin: Rollouts table empty: known issue when the canary is created but there are no recent requests tagged to that route version. UI filters to “last 1h” by default. if demo traffic is hitting the stable variant only, it looks blank.

Dylan Brooks: ah ok. can we change default to 24h for demo org? or at least make it obvious?

Chloe Martin: not in time for this week. but we can add a banner/empty-state copy: “No rollout events in selected time range” + link to adjust time range.

Talia Benson: for deck + script purposes can we get a list of “show live” vs “screenshot only”? I need to freeze it by EOD.

Markus Klein: what we’ve been doing in dry runs:
- Live: Project overview, Usage (cost + tokens), Latency breakdown, Errors list, Requests table, Route config (model pin + fallback), basic Rollouts (ONLY after we run synthetic traffic preset `rollout-canary`)
- Screenshot only: Model catalog benchmarks tab, Prompt sets/evals (it’s slow), Audit logs (entitlements differ + can distract)

Allison Grant: +1 on screenshot-only for Audit Logs. also it can surface a bunch of internal actor IDs that we end up explaining.

Logan Wright: for Traces specifically: live is fine IF you start from Console home -> select `Demo / Retail Search` project -> Observability -> Traces and set “Last 15 min”. deep links are what burn us.

Dylan Brooks: ok, let’s codify:
✅ Live-safe: Home/Overview, Usage (Cost Explorer), Performance (Latency), Requests, Errors, Route config + fallback policy, Rollouts (after generator)
⚠️ Conditional: Traces (only via navigation + correct time range)
🖼️ Screenshot-only: Model catalog benchmarks, Evals, Audit logs

Chloe Martin: model catalog 504 is a separate issue (backend query + caching). I’ll file a ticket + we’ll point demo to the “Models” list view only (not benchmarks tab).

Talia Benson: perfect. can someone drop the exact click path + any “don’t click this” notes? I’ll paste into the run-of-show doc.

Markus Klein: notes:
- Don’t click “Benchmarks” under Models
- Don’t open “Evals” unless we’re in backup mode
- For Rollouts: run generator preset first (`demo-traffic --preset rollout-canary --duration 3m`) then refresh rollouts page
- For Traces: avoid bookmarks; set time range manually

Allison Grant: I’ll add a small checklist to the demo scenario checklist doc + pin it. also will make sure #demo-oncall alert includes “synthetic traffic stale” signal so we catch empty dashboards.

Dylan Brooks: thanks all. I’ll update the demo talk track / run-of-show and ask Design for screenshots for the screenshot-only screens.
